title: 去公园玩

explanations.1: Indicates that the speaker and friend went together.
explanations.2: Describes the child as young or little.
explanations.3: Indicates the ongoing action of reading.
explanations.4: Specifies the direction as left side.
explanations.5: Marks the completion of taking photos.
explanations.6: Refers to the specific chair previously mentioned.
explanations.7: Indicates an unspecified amount of bread and fruit.
explanations.8: Means 'return' as in going back home.
explanations.10: Expresses ability: the cat can climb trees.
explanations.11: Introduces the companion (the cat) for playing.
explanations.13: Measure word for a cup of water.
explanations.15: Degree adverb emphasizing that the day is truly good.

translation: Today is the weekend, the weather is very good. My friend and I go to the park together by bus. On the bus, I see a little child reading a book. When we arrive at the park, we find a chair on the left side. We take a photo, then sit on that chair to rest. At noon we eat some bread and fruit. In the afternoon we go home. Today we had a lot of fun. We see a cat in a tree; it can climb trees. We play with it for a while. Later we go to a small shop on the east side. I buy a cup of water, and my friend buys ice cream. We are all very happy; today is really a good day.
